source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 9 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.184
closure: Full author mathematical body retained, with complete Theorem4.1 energy and local Sobolev approximation proof and every new centerline/John-domain/divergence-correction/capacitary core. Named minimum-dissipation and Bogovskii foundations remain precise source references. Only the fixed-configuration immersed-boundary Stokes approximation is selected; later shape/dynamics claims are unselected.
current_difficulty_reason: The centerline Stokeslet formula and minimum-dissipation principle do not give uniform errors as filament capacity degenerates. The authors prove the boundary and near-centerline asymptotics, construct divergence-free extensions with constants uniform in filament thickness, and build a capacitary test field for the local Sobolev error. These estimates produce the stated different logarithmic rates rather than a direct formal rescaling of a fixed-domain bound.
